raw.notable_prerequisites: You have at least six other cards in your graveyard, plus an additional four cards if Brain Freeze is in your graveyard.
raw.steps:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard for its escape cost by exiling three cards besides Brain Freeze from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time.
Cast Brain Freeze either from your hand by paying {1}{U}, or from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Brain Freeze's storm ability triggers, creating at least two copies of Brain Freeze targeting yourself, and any remaining copies targeting an opponent.
Resolve each Brain Freeze, causing yourself to mill nine cards and, if applicable, an opponent to mill three cards for each Brain Freeze remaining.
Repeat.

produces: Return all creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
raw.steps:
Cast Bloodline Necromancer by paying {4}{B}.
Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Inalla.
Resolve the Bloodline Necromancer trigger, returning Ruthless Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Inalla.
Resolve the Ruthless Technomancer trigger, causing you to sacrifice Bloodline Necromancer and create three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger from step 4, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Ruthless Technomancer with haste.
The Ruthless Technomancer token enters the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice the nontoken Ruthless Technomancer and create two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Inalla trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Bloodline Necromancer with haste.
The Bloodline Necromancer token enters the battlefield, returning Bloodline Necromancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 an arbitrarily large number of times.
If Inalla is not on the battlefield, activate an appropriate number of Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding enough mana to cast Inalla from the command zone.
If needed, cast Inalla from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{B}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
Activate Inalla by tapping five untapped Wizards you control, causing target player to lose 7 life.
Repeat step 14.

produces: Cast a subset of spells in your graveyard
Return all instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand
raw.steps:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Scholar of the Ages and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
The two Scholar of the Ages tokens enter the battlefield, returning Sacrifice, if applicable, and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing a Scholar of the Ages token, adding seven {B}.
Repeat.
You may also return up to two other instants and/or sorceries using the Scholar of the Ages tokens if they can be cast using black mana to get infinite casts of those instants and/or sorceries.
